name: Mikado Junsei
source:
A caring senior in both the literary and military arts. He is aiming to become a priest in the future.

A man with a refreshing conscience. He seems to be well-bred.

Hobby: Kendo

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160802174028/http://www.hanerom.dojin.com/p_mikado.html]official website[/url]]
